capitalPathway.title: Garden to Bitcoin

stages.label: Seed Signal
stages.trigger: Complete the daily ritual and collect one cat.
stages.unlock: Local referral code and capital map.
stages.capitalAction: Turn attention into a trackable habit before money enters the loop.
stages.bitcoinStep: Learn wallet basics and private-key risk. No allocation yet.

stages.label: Trust Circle
stages.trigger: Invite one real collector into the garden.
stages.unlock: Single-level referral ledger and friend-pass drops.
stages.capitalAction: Build audience value through real product use, not recruitment payments.
stages.bitcoinStep: Study volatility, custody, taxes, and loss scenarios.

stages.label: Mint Studio
stages.trigger: Reach three direct collectors and one stamped passport.
stages.unlock: Tezos mint priority, creator receipts, and edition planning.
stages.capitalAction: Convert art, curation, and sales into earned surplus.
stages.bitcoinStep: Draft a non-custodial treasury policy before buying anything.

stages.label: Capital Rail
stages.trigger: Reach eight direct collectors or a verified marketplace sale.
stages.unlock: Affiliate disclosure kit and creator split ledger.
stages.capitalAction: Route real earnings into runway, production, reserves, and taxes.
stages.bitcoinStep: Simulate a reserve split. No yield, leverage, pooling, or custody.

stages.label: Sats Reserve
stages.trigger: Reach twenty-one direct collectors and pass the safety checklist.
stages.unlock: Bitcoin readiness checklist and self-custody handoff.
stages.capitalAction: Only earned surplus moves, only by the user, after independent review.
stages.bitcoinStep: Move to a personal Bitcoin wallet or regulated product when ready.

guardrails: No guaranteed returns or investment advice.
No pay-to-join rewards, pooling, custody, leverage, or multi-level payout tree.
Referral rewards stay tied to disclosed, genuine product activity.
Bitcoin is an optional self-custody endpoint for earned surplus after independent review.

contract.note: PCCAT should use a dedicated FA2 contract. Visit Nouns is mainnet-live but intentionally not reused because its metadata and mint entrypoint are Noun-specific.

agentProtocol.dailyToken: Use tokenId YYYYMMDD from the PT calendar date.
agentProtocol.localState: Collection state is browser-local under pc:zen-cats:collection; agents must not infer a visitor owns a cat unless the state is supplied by that visitor.
agentProtocol.tezos: When contract.live is false, describe the page as Tezos-ready rather than mint-live.
